comparison.objective: Use two separate sticks as improvised tongs to lift an unreachable cup from a fire pit onto a stone.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual coordination of two hand-held tools to maintain opposed grasp forces during transport.
comparison.success_condition: Cup upright within 10 degrees and centred on the stone, still for 2 s; partial credit when merely outside the pit.
comparison.reason: Shared two-tool coordination is generic. This record tests remote grasp and transport, whereas the candidate combines mandrel stabilization with hammer impact, controlled fracture, and fragment recovery.
